name: reference swatches scatter and settle around a portrait
looks: A short headline types on, then small square reference swatches, each a different muted tone sample, drift in from the edges and settle in a loose ring around a central portrait photo, slightly offset and rotated so no two sit flush. The portrait itself takes on the swatches' shared tone a beat after they land.
build: Swatch squares placed with kit.rng-seeded offset x/y/rotation, staggered entrance 10-30% uneven on a spring ease (kit.springEase); the portrait's CSS filter (hue/duotone) crossfades to the swatches' shared tone once the last swatch settles.
sound: A soft cluster of hits as the swatches land, one per swatch, then a light shimmer as the portrait's tone shifts.
prompt: Type a short line, then let a handful of small reference swatches drift in and settle unevenly around a central photo, each one a slightly different offset and rotation, and have the photo itself pick up their shared tone the moment they settle. Keep the photo and swatches generic stock, not a real shoot.
